ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters covering approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blob located on the distal lateral region of the left lobe; small high-intensity white focal point at the distal tip of the right lobe; numerous dispersed circular white nodes concentrated towards the medial edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serration across the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude of variations increasing towards the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips, with a slight inward concave transition near the junction with the peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of over 30 distinct roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) distributed non-uniformly across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Cluster of at least three vertically oriented, parallel high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the proximal region of the left lobe near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear rake markings on the left lobe; irregular jagged erosion patterns at the outer terminal edges of both lobes.
